stem: An analyst builds a 95% interval for the mean order value as the mean ± 1.96 × SD, with an SD of €50 over 2,500 orders. What is wrong with it?

options.text: Nothing: the SD is the right input for any 95% interval
It needs the SE, €1, not the SD, so it is 50 times too wide
It should use 2.58 instead of 1.96, because it is about a mean
It is too narrow, because the SE is always larger than the SD
